title: Articulated fume/extraction arms over bench with caution sign
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.

Two articulated extraction or fume-arm assemblies are visible: one mounted at the right on the bench surface with a conical white hood (visible base and at least three articulated joints), and a second arm or arm segment suspended from the ceiling at the upper left of the image. Both assemblies are partially cropped where they meet ceiling or bench.
One long horizontal silver tubular arm segment runs from near the top-right toward the upper-left quadrant; it is connected into the right-side articulated assembly.
One vertical rectangular column or duct is visible near the upper-left, attached to the ceiling and supporting the suspended arm segment; it is partially cropped by the top edge of the image.
One workbench surface is visible across the lower third of the image with a wooden laminated front edge and a pale countertop.
One small triangular caution sign is visible on the lower right edge of the bench surface; only a portion of the sign is visible and it is partially cropped.
One overhead linear light fixture is visible at the top-left corner, cropped by the top edge of the image.
spatial_relations: The right-side articulated extraction arm is mounted on the bench surface near the lower-right quadrant; its base and conical hood rest on the bench and the arm rises upward with joints extending toward the top-right and then left.
A long silver tubular arm segment extends from the right assembly toward the upper-left, connecting visually to a ceiling-mounted rectangular column near the top-left.
The ceiling-mounted rectangular column is located behind and slightly left of the long silver tube; it appears to anchor the suspended arm segment.
The workbench runs horizontally across the bottom third of the image; the right-side extraction arm base sits on it and the caution sign is placed on the bench near the right edge.
A vertical seam or joint in a smooth grey wall panel is visible behind the arms, roughly centered in the image, dividing the background into left and right wall panels.
colours_and_materials: The articulated arms are predominantly white plastic at the joints and base with silver/metallic tubular sections; the conical hood is white.
The background wall panels are smooth light grey.
The ceiling area visible at the top is painted blue adjacent to the long silver arm; the underside of the ceiling near the light is pale green.
The bench countertop is a pale off-white or cream colour with a laminated wood front edge visible as a darker brown stripe.
The caution sign uses yellow and black (standard warning colours) and includes a black hazard pictogram on a yellow triangle.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether the left-side suspended assembly is a complete separate extraction arm or a continuation/segment of the right assembly because portions are cropped at the image edges.
Small printed text on the caution sign below 'SAFETY GLASSES' is not legible in the image and is represented as '[unreadable]'.
Any model, brand, or equipment nameplates on the arms or column are not legible from this image; no exact equipment nameplates or labels could be transcribed.
The exact number of joints per arm assembly beyond those clearly visible cannot be determined because parts are obscured or cropped by the image borders.
